why: Today's lead tooling fixes the source review's two reporting faults. Generated inputs use the installed Vitest matcher and its stack-or-message JSON form, including object summaries that hide received values. Those values stay unknown; only a fixed test file's numeric assertion location is retained. The real attempt boundary now writes validated request, caller, clock and runner facts before setup, keeps closed failure reasons and retains known outcomes after a transient result-write failure. Eight interpreter laws and the guided machine law passed with in-memory I/O. Two deliberate breaks failed assertions and were restored. Scoped format and lint passed. Full lint and the compiler remain owed while another compiler check holds the shared resource. No real adapter, protected law, dispatch or CI wait ran. Session usage and list-price cost remain unavailable.
